lane:
سرأل

اسرائيل إِسْرَائِيلُ a surname of [the patriarch] _Jacob;_ (Ksh and Bd * and Jel * in ii. 38;) also pronounced إِسْرَائِلُ, (Ksh and Bd ibid.,) and إِسْرَائِلُّ, (Ksh ibid.,) and إِسْرَالُ, and إِسْرَايِيلُ. (Bd ibid.) === And the name of _A certain angel;_ also pronounced إِسْرَائِينُ; in which the ن is asserted by Yaakoob to be a substitute for the ل. (TA.) === [But the ! is more properly to be regarded as a radical letter.]

entries.text: سرأل: إِسْرَائِيلُ وإِسْرائينُ: زَعَمَ يعقوب أَنه بدل اسم مَلَكٍ.
